input_contract: Input: a symmetric adjacency matrix isConnected as a list of lists of 0/1. Output: integer number of provinces.

variants.name: Union-Find
variants.strategy: Use union-find to merge connected computers; count distinct roots.

pseudocode: if connected, union the two nodes

variants.name: Depth-First Search
variants.strategy: Perform DFS from each unvisited node to explore connected component; increment province count.

pseudocode: for each unvisited node start DFS
in DFS: mark visited, explore neighbors
increment province count for each DFS start
if connected, union the two nodes
